player_prompt.intro:
You are playing Tower of Hanoi with {num_disks} disks.
You have to move the disks from tower A to tower C.
To move a disk, type the source tower and the target tower (e.g., '[A C]').
Note that you can only move the top disk of a tower, and that a bigger disk cannot be placed on a smaller disk.
At each turn, submit one move.

board.current_board: Kamitii ĩla yĩthĩawa na mũsyaĩĩsya ũmwe wa ovisi ũsu: {board}.

invalid_move.invalid_tower: Wasyaisye kana kĩsio kĩla ũkwenda kũthi no nginya wĩthĩwe na visa wa kwonany'a kũndũ kũla ũendete.
invalid_move.empty_tower: Wambĩĩie kwa kũtwaa ndata ĩte na kĩndũ.
invalid_move.same_tower: Na eka ũu, nĩwatatie kũlikya kyuo kĩu mĩtũkĩ nthĩnĩ wa ũla nyũmba weethĩie.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: Nĩwatatie kwĩkĩa kĩndũ kĩna kĩthũku mũno nthĩ ya kĩaa kĩu.

outcome.win: Congratulations! You solved the Tower of Hanoi puzzle.
outcome.turn_limit: The turn limit has been reached. You correctly placed {pct}% of the disks on Tower C.
